surface_name: Supabase Data API with row level security, UPDATE
title: Supabase update returns no error but changes nothing because the table has no SELECT policy
symptoms: update() resolves with error null and status 204 while the row is unchanged
An UPDATE policy exists and looks correct
cause: Postgres must be able to see a row before it can update it, so UPDATE under RLS also needs a matching SELECT policy. Rows hidden from SELECT are skipped silently.
fix: Add a SELECT policy covering the same rows as the UPDATE policy, and chain .select() in tests so a zero-row update is visible.
affected: All Supabase projects with RLS enabled; any client library
